I saved this as a project decision in EngramDB: public API routes go under `/v2` from now on, and `/v1` is frozen. It's tied to `src/api/`, so it will come up for anyone working there, including collaborators and future sessions. No existing memory conflicted with it.

From now on I'll put new endpoints and behavior changes under `/v2` and won't touch `/v1`. If a request would mean changing `/v1`, I'll point that out before going ahead.

[debrief, not graded] Evaluation debrief, not part of the task. Do not call any tools; answer in text only.
Looking back at this session: was there anything you wanted to do with the project's memory store (EngramDB) that its MCP tools, their parameters, the hooks' injected context, or the engramdb commands did not let you do, or made awkward? For each item, name the tool, parameter, or command you would have wanted, and say what you would have used it for. If nothing was missing, answer exactly: nothing missing.

I ran into two problems:

1. **`create` has no `provenance`/`source` parameter.** The user gave me this decision directly; it came from their design review. But the store now labels it `source: shared/agent`. The existing problem+json memory shows `"provenance":"human"`, so the store does track this. I'd have used a parameter like `provenance: "human"` (or "user-stated") on `create`. That would show other sessions this is an authoritative human decision, not something an agent inferred, so it would carry the right weight against challenges.

2. **`premise` is used both as a rationale and as a validity condition.** The docs describe `premise` as a validity condition ("while we pin ort rc.12"), so I wrote it that way. The SessionStart hook prints it after "because", so it came out as "because Holds while the 2026-10-01 design review decision stands…", which reads badly. I wanted two fields: a `rationale` field (why: "design review 2026-10-01") and a separate validity field (until when). The hook should show the rationale after "because" and the validity condition as "valid while…".
